name: filtro_cuda
description: Applies a bilateral filter to an image using CUDA GPU acceleration.

args.label: Block X
args.arg_description: Number of threads per block in the X dimension of the CUDA kernel. Together with blockY, defines the 2D block size used for parallel execution.

args.label: Block Y
args.arg_description: Number of threads per block in the Y dimension of the CUDA kernel. Together with blockX, defines the 2D block size used for parallel execution.
